measurement_status_legend.NOT_OBSERVED: No uniquely mapped observed source feature
measurement_status_legend.NOT_APPLICABLE: Not a uniquely mapped LR catalogue component; not negative

interpretation_boundary.rule_timing: Authored after all new model/source freezes, before viewing per-gene rankings or old results; post-source prioritisation, not a preregistered discovery test
interpretation_boundary.grade_A: Two original statistical streams: MAGMA BH<0.05 plus at least one patient main-contrast BH<0.05 with same-sign low/main/high QC effects and both sensitivity raw P<0.05
interpretation_boundary.grade_B: Exactly one or more such supported streams without satisfying A; not two-stream confirmation
interpretation_boundary.grade_C: Nominal genetic/patient P or main patient BH support not meeting the supported-stream criterion; exploratory only, not nomination-eligible
interpretation_boundary.eligibility: Protein-coding, nonzero detection in at least 6/8 donors under both primary and fixed stricter expression masks (all eight donor fields observed), plus genetic or QC-supported patient evidence. Grade and eligibility remain separate.
interpretation_boundary.sensitivity: Overlapping fixed QC cohorts; raw sensitivity P<0.05 is nominal and does not claim sensitivity BH significance or independent replication. Exact same original bulk feature retained.
interpretation_boundary.multiplicity: Native MAGMA and four separate main DESeq2 BH families unchanged. Any-contrast selection is exploratory prioritisation; descriptive minimum is not a new gene-level or across-four-contrast FDR.
interpretation_boundary.spatial: Normal surgical reference detection is tissue context, not an IBS-control replication or proof of effect direction. Stricter-mask checks are expression/mask descriptions, not model robustness refits.
interpretation_boundary.LR_and_markers: Full LR/marker statistics, negative and untested evidence remain available but are not a mandatory gate or hidden ranking bonus. Catalogue membership or donor-pair count cannot substitute for measured disease evidence.
interpretation_boundary.ranking: Eligible rows first, then explicit A/B/C/default grade and native MAGMA BH, descriptive main BH minimum and continuous donor detection tie-breaks. Exact ties use lexical HGNC identity only. No combined statistical score.
interpretation_boundary.feasibility: Independent source-cited human-model/expression/siRNA/IBS rationale and 2-4 proposed downstream qPCR transcripts follow statistical freeze; may explain a non-first-rank nomination without altering grades/order. Honest no-target outcome allowed.
interpretation_boundary.claims: Exploratory candidate prioritisation only; no causal-gene, direct-binding, pain mechanism, efficacy or generated wet-lab evidence.
